value.rationale: This resolves the physically motivated question whether covariance-matched Gaussianization is uniformly conservative over every Ramsey observation lag for a finite number of elementary fluctuators. The exact threshold in microscopic fluctuator count is distinct from the known oscillation onset; above it the Gaussian surrogate can underpredict coherence infinitely often. That global structural classification is not a trivial substitution or a single computed moment.
